note: The input-controlled IMAP SELECT response line from the fuzzer-backed server is available as the line parsed by the SELECT response handler.
A fixed 20-byte stack buffer is used for the UIDVALIDITY token even though the server response can contain an arbitrarily long run of digits before the closing bracket.
The scanset conversion writes the UIDVALIDITY digits and terminator into the stack buffer while parsing the input-controlled response.
